_note: ~/.claude/settings.json + settings.local.json — the five keys ccatlas cares about, plus a full key inventory. Values redacted except where structurally load-bearing. Claude Code 2.1.220.

enabledPlugins._note: Key form is plugin@marketplace — identical to the keys of installed_plugins.json.plugins and to the id field of `claude plugin list --json`. All 5 are true here; a false value is how a plugin is disabled without uninstalling it.

extraKnownMarketplaces._shape: Record<marketplaceName, { source: { source: "github"|"url"|"git"|..., repo?, url?, path?, ref? } }>
extraKnownMarketplaces._note: 3 entries here vs 4 in known_marketplaces.json. claude-plugins-official is ABSENT because it is auto-installed (see .claude.json officialMarketplaceAutoInstalled). Critically: NO autoUpdate field on any entry.

pluginConfigs._note: ABSENT on this machine. §3.2 lists it; there is no local fixture and its shape is unverified.

permissions._shape: { allow?: string[], deny?: string[], ask?: string[], additionalDirectories?: string[], defaultMode?: string }

_otherNotable.autoUpdatesChannel: "latest" — Claude Code CLI release channel, NOT a marketplace auto-update flag

enabledMcpjsonServers._note: Names the .mcp.json servers the user approved. Pairs with the per-project enabledMcpjsonServers / disabledMcpjsonServers arrays in ~/.claude.json.

settings.local.json._note: Does NOT carry enabledPlugins / extraKnownMarketplaces / pluginConfigs on this machine. Local scope overrides user scope only for the keys it defines.
